titolo: Google adds Voice Mode to Antigravity agent, boosts cheminformatics workflow
descr: Google's Antigravity 2.0 gains a live‑voice Chief of Staff agent and new Cheminformatics Skills that can design lung‑cancer drugs in an hour.
paragrafi: Google announced that Antigravity 2.0 will receive a new voice mode built for an agent currently called Chief of Staff. The mode supports live voice conversations, selectable voices, speech‑speed controls and optional text display.

Chief of Staff is presented as a dashboard‑style interface that can review pending conversations, generate personalized rules, flag attention‑requiring topics and discover skills or plugins. It may also coordinate subagents and scheduled tasks, extending Antigravity’s multi‑agent architecture.

In parallel, DeepMind released a technical walkthrough of Cheminformatics Skills for Antigravity. The skills integrate RDKit, ChEMBL and PubChem to let the agent extract, clean and analyze chemical data without manual wrangling.

Using these skills, the agent searched literature on lung‑cancer treatments, filtered thousands of compounds and proposed rigidified macrocycles such as lorlatinib within an hour, illustrating a dramatic speed‑up over traditional multi‑day cycles.

The combined voice interface and chemistry capabilities aim to turn Antigravity into a collaborative science workbench where language models orchestrate workflows while deterministic tools perform calculations.
perche: For AI practitioners, the voice‑first agent lowers the barrier to managing complex, multi‑step workflows on Antigravity, especially for developers handling many concurrent tasks. Researchers gain a faster, more interactive way to explore large chemical datasets, though the platform remains proprietary, highlighting the need for free or locally runnable alternatives for users who prefer open‑source or on‑premise solutions.
